overview.name: Corgi U.S. Equities 100% Struct
overview.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in investments that provide exposure to the U.S. Large-Cap Equity underlying funds consistent with the fund's policy adopted pursuant to Rule 35d-1 under the investment company act of 1940, as amended. It is non-diversified.
